claims.text: Flói was a member of Balin's folk who tried to reclaim Moria in . When they reached the Mirrormere, there was a great battle. Flói was valorous and killed the great chieftain, but was killed by a Goblin arrow.
claims.cite: Book of Mazarbul records "Flói was killed by an arrow. He slew the great [...] Flói under grass near Mirror mere"; J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, The Fellowship of the Ring, "The Bridge of Khazad-dûm"

claims.text: Although against the Dwarven traditions, he was buried under the grass near the Mirrormere. His death was recorded in the Book of Mazarbul.
claims.cite: J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, Appendix A, "Durin's Folk"; J.R.R. Tolkien, The Lord of the Rings, The Fellowship of the Ring, "The Bridge of Khazad-dûm"
